text:
In the first image, I feel a sense of calm detachment—wide open spaces, quiet illumination, and a sparse arrangement evoke reflection. The bean bag invites relaxation, yet the emptiness hints at anticipation, as though something is about to begin.

In the second image, I sense curiosity awakening. The vibrant wall, filled with text and multimedia, pulls my thoughts toward creativity, research, and innovation. Here, information is celebrated, asking me to engage and explore, to be part of a dynamic environment of discovery.
